identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
identity.core_concept: Liquid Luxury - A seamless blend of Dubai's heat (Orange) and modern coolness (Ash Grey/Glass).

visual_language.theme: Hybrid Premium (Light/Ash Grey Base with Dark/Glass Hero Sections)

headings.case: Sentence case for elegance, Uppercase for labels

liquid_glass.description: The signature look. Not just frosted, but wet and refractive.
liquid_glass.css_rule: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(180%); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.15), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

liquid_button.css_rule: relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(243,161,90,0.4)] hover:-translate-y-1 active:scale-95 before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-white/20 before:to-transparent before:translate-x-[-200%] hover:before:animate-[shimmer_1.5s_infinite]

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, py-24, gap-12. Avoid cramping.
layout_strategy.hero_section: Full viewport height (100vh). Video or high-res image background. Center aligned text with 3D elements floating.
layout_strategy.glass_overlay: Use glass panels floating over large images to hold text. Never place text directly on busy images without a scrim or glass card.

LiquidButton.instruction: Create a custom button component that implements the 'liquid_button' effect defined above. Use Brand Orange for the primary action, and Glass for secondary.

GlassCard.instruction: A container with the 'liquid_glass' effect. Use for Property Cards, Service Cards, and Testimonials.

Hero3D.instruction: Implement a R3F canvas in the Hero section. Show floating abstract geometric shapes (Sphere, Torus) in Glass material that slowly rotate. They should refract the background.

StatsCounter.instruction: Animated counters that count up when in view. Use big, thin typography.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for dark colors.
Do NOT center align the app container.
Use framer-motion for all scroll animations (fade-in-up, stagger).
Ensure 3D elements do not block text readability.
Mobile Responsiveness: 3D elements might need to be hidden or simplified on mobile.
